ns2:course.label: Geography & GIS Internship
ns2:course.description: Supervised, off-campus experience in a field directly pertaining to Geography and/or GIS. A written report is required at the end of the internship relating work accomplishments to the student's program of study. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in separate terms up to 6 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of faculty sponsor and Director of Undergraduate Studies; at least two courses taken within Geography & GIS.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in separate terms up to 6 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of faculty sponsor and Director of Undergraduate Studies; at least two courses taken within Geography & GIS.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MS:Geography -UIUC, BALAS: Geography & GIS - UIUC, BSLAS: Geography & GIS - UIUC, or MS:Geog:Geog Info Sci PSM-UIUC.
